name: tieryourlife-proxy
description: Server side of TierYourLife: keeps the Gemini and TMDB credentials off the device and meters generation

scripts.test:wipe: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,storage --project demo-tieryourlife-wipe "node --test lib-test/scripts/wipe-production.emulator.js"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth,storage --project demo-tieryourlife "node --test lib-test/scripts/smoke-e2e.emulator.js"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth
scripts.emulators:e2e: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth,storage --project demo-tieryourlife
scripts.emulators:e2e:exec: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth,storage --project demo-tieryourlife
